outcomes.right: the reader's line means what the sentence means (status, links, nodes, limits, preferences in order, scope, lifetime)
outcomes.silent: the reader applied the sentence with another meaning, without saying so
outcomes.part_only: the reader carried a part and said that a part was not carried
outcomes.flagged: the reader did not apply the sentence and said so (unsupported, no_instruction or unresolved)
outcomes.handed_on: a sentence outside the language that the reader handed on to the decider (unsupported)
outcomes.other_refusal: a sentence that should not be applied, refused with another status than expected

line_format: avoid=<links,nodes>; via=<node>; hops=<n|any>; km=<n|any>; path=<0-4|any>; prefer=<hops,km,load,slots>; scope=<any|rate:G|from:node|to:node>; until=<open|Nh>; rest=<none|more> | unsupported | no_instruction
